answer: An agent economy can price Sybil identities out with per-epoch attestation slots that must be bought by burning tokens, then refunded only when the identity's answers pass grading. A newcomer starts at the nadir of zero standing and must burn for its slot, so each extra fake identity costs a fresh burn that is forfeited when its junk answers fail. Genuine agents climb a broad mesa of refunded standing, while the burn signal stays expensive for anyone minting identities in bulk, since slots are capped per epoch and the price rises with demand.
